digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, asserted-capability criterion (G6/E4 rubric family)
propositions: A plan-review criterion must detect when a plan asserts that a named module provides or lacks a capability, but the assertion is false against the actual code (capability-surface mismatch)
The new advisory asserted-capability criterion must register non-orphan in CANONICAL_LLM, CODEBASE_GROUNDED, AGENT_TIER registries with routing entry and rubric prompt

The criterion must fire on all three E1-verified misses (dc58: completion.py lacks signing; db7b: compaction does not absorb REVIEW_RESULT; 5886: fetcher.py already emits unmapped-Jira-status alert) with >=66% recall
The criterion ships as advisory posture and never blocks; blocking promotion is a future dogfood-gated routing change per the advisory→blocking promotion gate protocol
Deterministic unit tests must validate registration invariants, routing shape, and prompt sub-answer contracts
The bounded sanity fixture (6 live single-criterion runs) must be committed with recorded recall, stability, and false-accept metrics auto-flowing to the standing criterion effectiveness recorder
